now.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
now.text: Nick Fury is the first to greet Steve Rogers when he wakes up in the present after decades in the ice.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The soldier Fury greets on waking from the ice.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The first man to greet Steve when he wakes from the ice.

proposed.text: When Steve Rogers wakes in the present after decades in the ice and runs out into Times Square, Nick Fury meets him there and tells him he has been asleep for almost 70 years.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The man who meets Steve in Times Square after he wakes from the ice.

changes.evidence: Captain America: The First Avenger: on waking in the staged 1940s room Steve is first greeted by a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent posing as staff ('good afternoon'); he flees into Times Square, where Fury then meets him and tells him he has been asleep almost 70 years. Fury is not the first to greet him.

now.title: Captain America: Civil War
now.text: Years later, as Crossbones, Rumlow leads the attack in Lagos, and Sam chases down his truck and his men.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An old foe who chases Rumlow's truck and men in Lagos.
now.on_b_card_about_a: As Crossbones, leads the Lagos attack that Sam helps stop.

proposed.text: Years later, Rumlow leads a mercenary attack in Lagos, and Sam chases down his truck and his men.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Sam's old foe, who leads the Lagos attack that Sam helps stop.

changes.evidence: Name rule: Rumlow is never called 'Crossbones' in Captain America: Civil War (Wikipedia cast note: 'HE IS NEVER CALLED THAT IN THE FILM'; fandom sources the codename only to the Civil War Prelude Infinite Comic, a tie-in). The Lagos attack itself is right.

now.title: Captain America: Civil War
now.text: Scarred and calling himself Crossbones, Rumlow tries to kill Steve with a suicide bomb in Lagos.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The man Rumlow tries to kill with a suicide bomb.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Scarred and calling himself Crossbones, tries to kill Steve with a suicide bomb.

proposed.text: Scarred and out for revenge, Rumlow tries to kill Steve with a suicide bomb in Lagos.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Scarred and out for revenge, tries to kill Steve with a suicide bomb.

changes.evidence: Name rule: the name 'Crossbones' is never said or shown in Captain America: Civil War (Wikipedia cast note says so explicitly; fandom cites only the tie-in Prelude comic for the codename). The suicide bomb in Lagos is right.

now.title: Daredevil S1#1
now.text: Daredevil fights Anatoly Ranskahov and his brother's Russian mob in Hell's Kitchen.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Fights Anatoly's Russian mob in Hell's Kitchen.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Russian mob leader Matt fights in Hell's Kitchen.

proposed.text: As a masked vigilante, Matt Murdock fights the Russian mob run by Anatoly Ranskahov and his brother in Hell's Kitchen.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Russian mob leader whose men Matt fights in Hell's Kitchen.

changes.evidence: The name 'Daredevil' is first given in Daredevil S1#13 ('The vigilante is named "Daredevil" by the media'; the showrunner chose a newspaper headline rather than saying it earlier). In S1#1 he is only the masked man. In S1#1 he fights the Ranskahovs' men at the docks (freeing the women); Anatoly hears of it at the meeting, he is not fought in person until S1#4.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
now.text: After Loki kills Coulson, Fury secretly brings him back through Project T.A.H.I.T.I. When S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Fury makes Coulson director of a new S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The agent Fury secretly brings back to life, then names director.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's boss, who secretly brings him back and makes him director.

proposed.text: Back on duty after Loki's attack, Coulson leads a field team for S.H.I.E.L.D. under Director Fury.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fury's agent, back on duty after Loki's attack and leading a field team.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's director, who oversees his new field team.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#11
split.text: Coulson learns he was dead for days after Loki's attack and was brought back to life on Fury's orders.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The agent Fury had brought back from the dead.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's director, on whose orders he was brought back from the dead.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22
split.text: Fury joins Coulson to face Garrett, then names him the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The agent Fury names the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's old boss, who names him the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.

changes.evidence: Stage starts at AoS S1 (#1) but tells later reveals: Streiten tells Coulson he was resurrected on Fury's orders in S1#11 'The Magical Place'; the T.A.H.I.T.I. name surfaces in S1#14; Fury appoints Coulson Director in S1#22 'Beginning of the End'. At S1#1-#2 Coulson simply works under Director Fury (who scolds him in #2).

now.title: Secret Invasion
now.text: Grown up, G'iah drifts toward Gravik's rebels before siding with her father. When Gravik kills Talos, she grieves him and carries on his fight.
now.on_a_card_about_b: G'iah's father. She drifts from him, sides with him, then grieves his death.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Talos's daughter, who drifts toward Gravik's rebels before siding with her father.

proposed.text: Grown up, G'iah has joined Gravik's rebels, but once Talos tells her Gravik killed her mother, she secretly feeds him the rebels' plans.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: G'iah's father. She secretly feeds him Gravik's plans.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Talos's daughter, inside Gravik's rebels, who secretly feeds him their plans.

split.title: Secret Invasion#4
split.text: Gravik kills Talos during the attack on President Ritson's convoy, and G'iah is left to carry on his fight.
split.on_a_card_about_b: G'iah's father, killed by Gravik. She carries on his fight.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Talos's daughter, who carries on his fight after Gravik kills him.

changes.evidence: Stage is at Secret Invasion (#1) but tells Talos's death, which happens in #4 'Beloved' (Gravik kills Talos while he and Fury extract Ritson); his funeral is #5. In #1 Talos tells G'iah the rebels killed Soren and she reveals Gravik's bomb plan; she keeps spying for him in #2-#3.
